intent: A ranger's briefing: calm, exact, slightly dangerous. Numbers like a field guide.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).
title: Where do KOMODO DRAGONS live in the wild?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: Where do komodo dragons live in the wild?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Indonesia: a few islands in the Lesser Sundas, Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and nowhere else on Earth.

lines.direction: count them, slow at the end
lines.text: And there are only about 3,400 of them left in the wild. That is the whole species.

lines.direction: island hop, one pin per name
lines.text: Komodo, Rinca, Flores. The national park, set up in 1980, guards most of them.
Its bite carries venom, proven in 2009, and the species is now listed as endangered.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
lines.text: A dragon with a postcode. Follow us.
